dataIdInfo.idPurp: Subcatchment Update: 2022_01_31 Includes watershed study update for Pheasant Branch, Wingra West, Stricker's Mendota, Spring Harbor and Lower Badger Mill Creek.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
Includes finalizes subcatchment basins from consultants (WW, SM, SH, DM) and Caroline Burger (PB). Boundary data needs to be rectified along Lower Badger Mill Creek and Pheasant Branch. Portions of model areas that are not included in the watershed studies are delineated as "Not Modeled" under the Watershed Field.

Adjustments to Lower Badger Mill data were justified to the Pheasant Branch subcatchment delineation. These areas should be reviewed.
dataIdInfo.idCredit: Original boundaries (Stricker's Mendota/Spring Harbor/Wingra West) added by Richie Breidenbach. Updated subcatchments for Pheasant Branch provided by Caroliine Burger.
